profile.summary: A roofing and general contracting company based in San Leandro, California. It has worked in the Bay Area since 2004 and provides roof replacement, repair, waterproofing and maintenance for homes, businesses, schools and other public buildings. It holds California B (general) and C-39 (roofing) contractor licenses.

review.notes: The company website and the OUSD Legistar record (Change Order No. 1, Roosevelt Middle School Gym) both name RK Roofing & Construction, San Leandro, CA, matching the agenda. Name, address, phone, generic admin email, 2004 start and B/C-39 licenses are shown on the site; the summary is neutral.
